note: S/4HANA 2025, fr0ster/mcp-abap-adt#351 live measurement (Eclipse's second step): a fresh function group in a transportable package with its main program changed. The group's reference alone with preauditRequested=true (01) answered ioc:inactiveObjects; every reference that answer lists — the group and its source/main, which the answer types FUGR/F, with its parentUri — was posted as given with preauditRequested=false (02), answered chkl:messages activationExecuted="true", and the inactive list at once (03) and about 10 s later (04) is empty: the group activated. Transport numbers are placeholders. This step: read about 10 s after step 02.

request.headersNote: Caller-supplied headers only. Recorded by a hand-run probe over HTTP; it added Authorization, sap-client, the stateful-session header, the session cookie and the CSRF token, none of which is recorded. Of the response headers only content-type was kept.
